entries.name: William Worthy

expected.sentence: Three months imprisonment and nine months probation originally imposed in the passport prosecution; judgment and sentence reversed February 20, 1964, with remand for discharge. No verified physical admission or release date is established. The unsupported November 14, 2013 sentence/admission and FCI Petersburg attribution have been removed; reversal is not encoded as a physical release.
